text:
nina-product: Heads-up team: tight prelaunch freeze starts in 20m for the EU slice. This thread is the single canonical warmdown + rollback checklist. Keep replies short.

alex-release: callouts: release-notes PR #432 must be merged before lift. No new feature pins during freeze.

sara-sre: infra checks: confirm node spare capacity >=2 nodes, GPU mem headroom >=12%, alert for restart-loop >3 in 5m.

ben-oncall: who owns immediate rollback actions if regression hits? I'll take coordination and posting to #release-war-room.

sara-sre: I'll own infra rollback (move traffic to fallback pool + drain). Signal: GPU errors >1% or node restarts >4 in 10m.

alex-release: I'll own model pin revert and release notes updates. Revert API snippet in runbook: `POST /admin/pins/revert {"slice":"eu-1","to":"stable-2026-02"}`

deploy-bot: Initiating quiet window: applying policy 'freeze-eu-2026-03' -> blocking new pins, uploads, and noncritical deploys.

deploy-bot: Quiet window active. Enforcement: API returns 403 for pin endpoints. Logs: https://dash.internal/quiet/4890001234

nina-product: Launch checklist (short): 1) release notes merged 2) smoke suite green 3) deploy-bot shows quiet window active 4) oncall + owners present 5) rollback runbook reachable

marta-qe: (in thread via DM) smoke suite scheduled at T+5m, T+15m. I'll post counts here.

ben-oncall: Confirmed: I will post a rollback message format to #release-war-room: "cause | action | owner | time" so it's quick to read.

sara-sre: alerts created: `freeze/eu-gpu-pressure` (3m), `freeze/eu-restarts` (5m). Dash links in runbook.

alex-release: Added release-notes PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/432. Please review changelog bullets now.

marta-qe: first smoke run: 1 minor mismatch in NER model (out of 200 tests). Latency p95 +8% but within threshold.

nina-product: minor mismatch tolerated; threshold for rollback remains: user-facing failures >0.8% sustained 5m OR 10+ NLU test regressions in a 20m window.

sara-sre: infra note: if we see OOM on gpu-node-7, we will mark it cordoned and route around. Command in runbook: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7 && kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets`

ben-oncall: If rollback is started, sequence: 1) announce in #release-war-room 2) run pin revert (alex) 3) pause traffic ramp (deploy-bot) 4) infra to route to fallback (sara) 5) post short RCA later.

deploy-bot: Traffic ramp plan: increase to 15% over 12m -> hold for 10m -> continue if metrics stable. Current: 0% -> ramp scheduled.

marta-qe: second smoke (T+15m): 0 regressions / 200 checks. Good to continue.

alex-release: release-notes merged. Tag `v2026-03-eu` created. No objections to proceeding.

sara-sre: monitoring green. Prepared fallback commands.

ben-oncall: final check: all owners present? nina, alex, sara, marta?
nina-product: present.
alex-release: present.
sara-sre: present.
marta-qe: present.

ben-oncall: ok. Proceeding with ramp at T+2m. Keep all critical updates in this thread; if rollback triggered, move incident to #release-war-room with the short format. Good luck. :rocket:
